S.TRANSL: When we went to the foreign country,
(unan)

S.FORM: ni-misa-namen lu ditanasay nimi-namen ni-mitku tu vagay Darikud
ni-misa-namen lu ditanasay nimi-namen ni-mitku tu vagay Darikud
S.TRANSL: we spent the night at Ditanasay, and we slept in Darikud's(unctn) house.
The next morning, we had one bowl of food each.
The next morning, we had one bowl of food each.
When we got to the wharf,
the soldiers looked at our names
the soldiers looked at our names
one after the other, and then we disembarked.
one after the other, and then we disembarked.
They didn't want the man from Iranmiluk to go first.
The soldiers made him go back in a hurry.
So one of us was left over there.

S.FORM: yaru karwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira a-ni-padi-rana
yaru karwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira a-ni-padi-rana
S.TRANSL: Many, many other foreigners accompanied us.

S.FORM: yaru karwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira a-ni-machyura-rana
yaru karwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira a-ni-machyura-rana
S.TRANSL: Many, many other foreigners accompanied us.
We all traveled by bus
We all traveled by bus
to Taytu.
to Taytu.

S.FORM: makasasned namen-em nimi-namen ni-makasasned namen di-sinku
makasasned namen-em nimi-namen ni-makasasned namen di-sinku
S.TRANSL: We arrived at Sinku.

S.FORM: ditagen namen u araw-em ni-maligen u araw
ditagen namen u araw-em ni-maligen u araw
S.TRANSL: Looking at the sun, we saw that it was mid-day.
We just had a little money.
We just had a little money.

S.FORM: walem-nem-a k-angay-nemn-a-rana u mavang tu alilu
walem-nem-a k-angay-nemn-a-rana u mavang tu alilu
S.TRANSL: We walked up to where we boarded the bus.

S.FORM: walem-namen-a k-angay-namen-a-rana u mavang tu alilu
walem-namen-a k-angay-namen-a-rana u mavang tu alilu
S.TRANSL: We walked up to where we boarded the bus.
We gave over one hundred dollars and fifty cents over there to get here.
And so we arrived at Taytu and here
the doors were shut.
the doors were shut.
the doors were shut.
